text.content:
Small, loud, and too kind for the job.

Role: Solo
Affiliation: Maine's crew
Known for: Being the daughter of Papa Sunrise

Spoilers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. Born and raised in Night City, the daughter of the edgerunner Papa Sunrise, who vanished one day. Emotional, unpredictable and compassionate, all of which keeps getting in the way of the work.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.40
